label: Merc -- SECOND TOTAL REBUILD: Tactical Operator, face exposed (v2)
note: Second full rebuild this session -- direction confirmed via AskUserQuestion after the user asked for research on Starship Troopers / The Expanse and explicitly invited a fork between 'human,' 'battle suit,' and 'the space suit already shipped': landed on TACTICAL HELMET, FACE EXPOSED. Research anchors: Starship Troopers' M-3 Tactical Helmet (wraparound visor/'snooper,' side-mounted lamp/camera modules, angular not round) and The Expanse's MCRN Goliath powered armor (silver/red segmented plating, an angular faceplate called out as an actual weak point in the show). Concept: a modern special-forces HALF-SHELL helmet (stops above the brow) with goggles pushed UP onto the front rim and his real human face exposed below, using every face technique proven this session (Vossmark Officer, Mentalist, Netrunner): real temple + nose-bridge eye gaps, a proper brow shadow, a shaded nose bridge, a firm closed mouth, a stubbled jaw. Per an earlier explicit direction on this character ('dropped the cyborg-eye detail'), both eyes stay plain/human -- the green identity glow moved onto his GEAR instead (tinted goggle lenses). Preserved because it already worked: the rifle's barrel/receiver/magazine/stock geometry with a real angle-bend, ported from the space-suit build essentially unchanged. v1 self-caught two bugs (helmet-rim using the skin-light color instead of helmet material; stubbled jaw fusing into the collar) before first presenting. v2, per direct feedback ('center the legs... add what detail you can and tighten it up'): found the legs centered a full column right of the head (12.5 vs 11.5, verified by checking outline positions directly, not eyeballing) with nothing -- no rifle, no asymmetric prop -- to justify the drift; shifted the whole leg+boot block left by 1px to align under the head. Added detail: a chin-strap line down the jaw, a shoulder radio/comms box with a short antenna, a diagonal chest-rig strap down the vest's left side (kept clear of the rifle's own geometry), tactical knee-pad accents, and an ankle-strap band on both boots. NOT shipped -- the closed-helmet sibling (same body, sealed visor + blue eye-hint) was chosen instead and is now the live `heroMerc`/`merc` in data.js; this face-exposed variant is kept staged here as the runner-up alternative. The old space-suit design is archived separately as `mercSpaceSuitLegacy`.
